name: K Z Leasing and Finance Limited
summary: KZ Leasing & Finance Limited functions as a financial services provider, delivering an extensive array of offerings. These encompass funding for micro-entrepreneurs and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), alongside consumer credit options such as those for two, three, and four-wheelers, personal needs, and home acquisitions. The company also extends gold loans, agricultural financing, leasing arrangements, and specialized microfinance facilities. Established on August 7, 1986, its primary operational base is located in Ahmedabad, India.
